question_en:
A maintenance colleague plans to include a batch of official teardown diagrams in an internal manual but first needs to identify any 2D machine codes in the images that could be directly scanned. The attachment shows the internal structure of one such device. Please answer the following questions:

1. What are the product name, specific version, and model number of the device in the image?
2. Search for the collection of repair guides for this device and check the cover image of each guide marked as official one by one. Which cover images contain at least one clear square QR code or other 2D machine-readable code? List the guide number, title, difficulty, and revision number of the consulted version for the corresponding guides.

Answer Format: Please answer in points numbered (1)–(2); answer Question 1 in text; for Question 2, list all matching guides item by item in a table, including the guide number, title, difficulty, and revision number of the consulted version.

## Step 01 · Identify Device Version from Internal Structure

Action: Observe the input left/right control boards, central fan, bottom battery, and handheld chassis. Example query: Steam Deck OLED internal battery fan teardown iFixit.

Evidence Observation: The image suggests a model in the Steam Deck series. Do not conflate the LCD and OLED versions based solely on the handheld’s exterior; continue comparing the internal photos and model descriptions in the device category.

Evidence Links:
https://www.ifixit.com/api/2.0/categories/Steam_Deck_OLED

Result of this step: Shift from appearance-based candidates to specific version verification.

Action: Read wiki_title and description via the Steam_Deck_OLED category API, rather than relying solely on recommended guide titles.

Evidence Observation: The category explicitly identifies the product as Steam Deck OLED, released by Valve on 2023-11-16, with model number 1030. The original image corresponds to the OLED internal structure; Model 1030 is the device model number, not a specific guide ID.
